messages:
maya: FYI team, rolling out tightened SLO burn-rate detection + a short controlled load test. Please read and ack if you have any conflicts.

maya: Policy change TL;DR:
- trigger: burn-rate >= 3x baseline for 10m => pause canaries + incident open
- previous: soft page at 5x for 15m. This is to surface regressions earlier.
- runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo-burnrate (please review)

maya: Planned maintenance & load test:
- When: Tue Mar 30 2026 02:00 - 03:30 UTC
- Scope: Controlled query load against canary pools in us-west-2 and eu-central-1, plus simulated AZ failover to exercise routing fallback and KV-cache warmup.
- Impact: No planned customer downtime; expect transient latency/error increases in canaries. We'll stop promotions during window.

alex: Question 100 Does the new trigger auto-rollback or just pause and open an incident?

maya: No auto-global rollback. It pauses canaries and opens the incident; SRE/manual ops decide on rollback/promote.

jonathan: Monitoring plan: I'll create a temp dashboard with p50/p95/99 latency, error rate, kv-cache miss-rate, serve queue length, and token time. Pager if error-rate > 25% for 5m or latency p99 > 2s for 10m.

priya: I'll prepare targeted customer comms for enterprise accounts and add a status tile if anything user-facing changes. Also asking release owners to avoid promotions 01:30-04:00 UTC that day.

oncall-bot: Calendar event created: "SLO burn-rate rollout + controlled loadtest" Tue Mar 30 02:00-03:30 UTC 1 invites: #eng-sre, #eng-runtime, #product-ops.

maya: Important pre-checks:
- Verify canary pool tagging and weights
- Validate KV cache retention policy on canaries
- Confirm alert hooks and pager rotation for the window
- Make sure rollback/protect playbooks are reachable

maya: Quick abort snippets (copyable):
```
# abort loadtest
kubectl scale deploy/loadtest -n stress --replicas=0
# isolate canary pool
infractl routing set-weight --pool canary --weight 0
# resume normal traffic
infractl canary resume --namespace staging
```

tanya: Acked 1 I'll be on-call that night and can join the incident channel if anything fires.

alex: Ack 1 disabled auto-promote for the window and pinged release owners.

jonathan: I'll drop dashboard and alert links ~1h before start in this thread.

priya: :eyes: drafting customer notes now.

maya: Thanks. If no other blockers, react with :eyes: and we'll proceed with the schedule.
